sheets.title: Arming the wipe mode, Settings > Security > Duress code - 390 x 844
sheets.caption: A password vault is sealed on an empty device and Settings > Security > Duress code > Add is opened. The journey picks the Wipe mode where the build has it, types the code twice, the word WIPE and ticks the mode's sentence. Same journey on both builds; the base build has no third mode, no word field and no wipe sentence.
sheets.after: 3 modes; word field 322x44 at 16px, sentence box 44x44, no sideways scroll

sheets.title: The unlock side after typing the code, cold load - 390 x 844
sheets.caption: The same device after the code is armed, the vault is locked, the code is typed at the password prompt and the page is loaded cold. The base build never armed a wipe, so the code is just a wrong guess and the vault is still asked for; the branch has removed it, and the first screen is the one a device with no vault gets.
sheets.before: 1 password field: the vault is still asked for
sheets.after: 0 password fields: Sign in, no vault offered
